api_operation.authorization: Owner-reported instance-root token, read from mode-0600 temporary file and sent over encrypted root SSH to the host-local Coolify API. The token value was not recorded.

verification.method: Read-only transaction against Coolify metadata; selected only the target application's include_source_commit_in_build boolean.

next_controls: Do not use the instance-root token again.
Downgrade the existing token to app-scoped deploy-only before any deployment.
Review a fresh encrypted recovery checkpoint and G4/G5 prerequisites before candidate rollout.
